b: Makera has announced their 4th benchtop CNC milling machine, the A1S.
First came the Carvera, then the Carvera Air. The beginner-friendly Z1 was announced last year (see The Makera Z1 is a New Benchtop CNC for Beginners).
The A1S is an upgraded version of the “Classic Air CNC.”
The Carvera Air earned its place in thousands of workshops. From Makera, trusted by tens of thousands of users — what they asked for went into what comes next.
Thus, it seems that the Makera A1S is their new mainstream desktop CNC, positioned below the Carvera and above the Z1.
There’s a lot of information to digest. Let’s start from the beginning.
3D printers are great for building up parts. Plastic parts, even from engineering materials, aren’t always the way to go.
With a benchtop CNC machine, you start with a block (billet) of metal, and the machine cuts away to shape your parts.
The materials you can cut with a CNC machine are generally determined by its rigidity. This is a benchtop machine.
A1S is optimized for aluminum alloys (6061/6063/7075), brass, and copper.
Processable material: steel (iron) parts — with the officially recommended depth of cut and feed parameters and suitable tooling, steel machining can be completed.

Some other benchtop CNC makers are claiming their aluminum-framed machines can cut steel and titanium. Realistically, an aluminum-framed machine will be optimized for non-ferrous materials such as aluminum, brass, common plastics, and wood
It’s good to see Makera setting realistic expectations.
The A1S “ultimate bundle” lists out the types of compatible attachments and add-ons:
Here’s a rundown of the features:
Custom collet with 1/8 in integrated (optional: 1/4 in, 6 mm, 4 mm, 3 mm)
There is an automatic tool changer (ATC) version, with some differences.
A1S uses the 3D Wired Probe (Makera 3D Wired Probe); A1S ATC uses the 3D Wireless Probe (Makera 3D Wireless Probe).

For the minimum quantity lubrication (MQL) system, Makera recommends the California Air Tools 2010A 2-gallon air compressor, or 8010 / 8010A 8-gallon models. They also recommend Coolube 2210AL for general-purpose metal machining.
A1S vs A1S-ATC Maximum Work Area Dimensions
The ATC can be removed to accommodate larger workpieces and for pass-through machining

Dimensions: 50 cm (Width) × 45 cm (Depth) × 45 cm (Height) / 19.7 in × 17.7 in × 17.7 in
Max height with lid open: 84 cm / 33 in

A1S ATC MSRP: $4299
A1S ATC Preorder Price: $3499 (save $800)

Makera says shipping will start in January 2027, with 45-70 days of estimated transit time, plus additional delays due to Chinese New Year. By my estimate, this means preorders will likely be fulfilled starting around March or April, on a first-come first-served basis.
The minimum quantity lubrication (MQL) add-on can be purchased with the A1S or A1S-ATC at a discount, or separately for $599.
Makera is offering a 15% discount on accessories ordered at the same time as the A1S preorder.
